fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: The rock's thickness through the gameplay plane, front to back

fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: The rock's thickness through the gameplay plane, front to back

fields.label: Fractures
fields.description: Slabs per square metre of outline (at least 2): how densely they overlap

fields.label: Slab width
fields.description: A slab's width across the outline, about its middle (75 to 125 %): the same at any outline size

fields.label: Slab length
fields.description: A slab's length up the outline, about its middle (61 to 139 %): the same at any outline size

fields.label: Weathering
fields.description: How irregular each slab's corners and long edges are

fields.label: Face budget
fields.description: Faces kept per 30 m² of rock surface

fields.label: Remesh detail
fields.description: Remesh resolution: finer as it rises

fields.label: Voxel cap
fields.description: Largest remesh voxel, whatever the outline

fields.label: Edge bevel
fields.description: Width of the bevel on every sharp edge: well under a millimetre it draws a fine highlight along each crease; 0 leaves the edges sharp

fields.label: Stone size
fields.description: Every stone's physical size times this, including its steps, bevels, curvature-split minimum and small-fragment threshold

fields.label: Surface relief
fields.description: Depth of projecting cleavage planes and offset folds, as a share of Stone size; zero keeps the shallow roof taper

fields.label: Joint length
fields.description: Primary fracture length along local Z, relative to stone width

fields.label: Merge small
fields.description: A stone under this share of its kind's median volume is joined to its neighbour instead of standing as a knub

fields.label: Curve split
fields.description: Degrees a cell's surface must turn in gentle bends before it splits into smaller stones; lower keeps more curves round

variants.label: Boulder
variants.description: Irregular polygon cells with the original boulder surface

variants.label: Cliff
variants.description: Directional fractures, anchored stones and crisp broad cleavage planes

variants.label: Wall
variants.description: Overlapping vertical slabs fused over the guide into one continuous rock face
